package course

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
)

type courseOutlineRepositoryStub struct {
	outline  *domain.CourseOutline
	err      error
	courseID string
	lang     string
}

func (r *courseOutlineRepositoryStub) GetPublic(_ context.Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseOutline, error) {
	r.courseID = courseID
	r.lang = lang
	if r.err != nil {
		return nil, r.err
	}
	return cloneCourseOutline(r.outline), nil
}

type courseOutlineReadAccessStub struct {
	courseID  string
	lessonIDs []string
	items     map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution
}

func (r *courseOutlineReadAccessStub) ResolveLessonReadAccess(_ context.Context, lessonIDs []string, _ bool) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error) {
	return r.resolve(lessonIDs), nil
}

func (r *courseOutlineReadAccessStub) ResolveCourseLessonReadAccess(_ context.Context, courseID string, lessonIDs []string) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error) {
	r.courseID = courseID
	r.lessonIDs = append([]string(nil), lessonIDs...)
	return r.resolve(lessonIDs), nil
}

func (r *courseOutlineReadAccessStub) resolve(lessonIDs []string) map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution {
	result := make(map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, len(lessonIDs))
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		if item, ok := r.items[lessonID]; ok {
			result[lessonID] = item
		}
	}
	return result
}

func TestGetCourseOutline_AttachesCourseScopedAudienceDecisions(t *testing.T) {
	outlineRepo := &courseOutlineRepositoryStub{outline: outlineFixture()}
	accessRepo := &courseOutlineReadAccessStub{items: map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution{
		"lesson-1": {Effective: domain.LessonReadAccessGuest, SourceType: "section", SourceID: "section-1"},
		"lesson-2": {Effective: domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro, SourceType: "lesson", SourceID: "lesson-2"},
	}}
	uc := GetCourseOutline{
		Outlines: outlineRepo,
		Access:   contentaccess.Service{ReadAccess: accessRepo},
	}

	result, err := uc.Handle(contentaccess.WithAudience(context.Background(), "STUDENT"), " course-1 ", "ru")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle() error = %v", err)
	}
	if outlineRepo.courseID != "course-1" || outlineRepo.lang != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("outline request = %q/%q, want course-1/ru", outlineRepo.courseID, outlineRepo.lang)
	}
	if accessRepo.courseID != "course-1" {
		t.Fatalf("access course = %q, want course-1", accessRepo.courseID)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(accessRepo.lessonIDs, []string{"lesson-1", "lesson-2"}) {
		t.Fatalf("resolved lessons = %#v", accessRepo.lessonIDs)
	}

	lessons := result.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons
	if !lessons[0].CanRead || lessons[0].EffectiveReadAccess != domain.LessonReadAccessGuest {
		t.Fatalf("guest lesson decision = %#v", lessons[0])
	}
	if lessons[1].CanRead || lessons[1].EffectiveReadAccess != domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro {
		t.Fatalf("pro lesson decision = %#v", lessons[1])
	}
	if result.Modules[0].Order != 2 || result.Modules[0].Sections[0].Order != 3 || lessons[0].Order != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("authored order changed: %#v", result.Modules[0])
	}
}

func TestGetCourseOutline_RejectsMissingAccessResolution(t *testing.T) {
	uc := GetCourseOutline{
		Outlines: &courseOutlineRepositoryStub{outline: outlineFixture()},
		Access: contentaccess.Service{ReadAccess: &courseOutlineReadAccessStub{
			items: map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution{
				"lesson-1": {Effective: domain.LessonReadAccessGuest},
			},
		}},
	}

	_, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), "course-1", "en")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("Handle() error = %v, want ErrNotFound", err)
	}
}

func outlineFixture() *domain.CourseOutline {
	return &domain.CourseOutline{
		CourseID: "course-1",
		Slug:     "course-one",
		Title:    "Course One",
		Modules: []domain.CourseOutlineModule{{
			ID:    "module-1",
			Title: "Module One",
			Order: 2,
			Sections: []domain.CourseOutlineSection{{
				ID:    "section-1",
				Title: "Section One",
				Order: 3,
				Lessons: []domain.CourseOutlineLesson{
					{ID: "lesson-1", Title: "Lesson One", Order: 4, TasksCount: 2},
					{ID: "lesson-2", Title: "Lesson Two", Order: 5},
					{ID: "lesson-1", Title: "Lesson One Again", Order: 6, TasksCount: 2},
				},
			}},
		}},
	}
}

func cloneCourseOutline(input *domain.CourseOutline) *domain.CourseOutline {
	if input == nil {
		return nil
	}
	result := *input
	result.Modules = make([]domain.CourseOutlineModule, len(input.Modules))
	for moduleIndex, module := range input.Modules {
		result.Modules[moduleIndex] = module
		result.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections = make([]domain.CourseOutlineSection, len(module.Sections))
		for sectionIndex, section := range module.Sections {
			result.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex] = section
			result.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Lessons = append([]domain.CourseOutlineLesson(nil), section.Lessons...)
		}
	}
	return &result
}
